final:
Done. In #release-updates, I replied in-thread to "The rollout checklist for the export update is ready…" (ts 1735808760.000001) — the only rollout-checklist message whose 🚀 reaction came from a #beta-testers member (Harold, who is in #beta-testers-west). Note: three other checklist messages also had 🚀 reactions, but all from Ethan, who isn't in any beta-testers channel — so the export-update message was the right target.
